_comment: Shared contract between backend/app/core/sentences.py and study-app/src/lib/sentences.ts. Both must produce exactly these splits. Add a case here first, then make both implementations pass it.

cases.why: the bug that started this: an abbreviated title is not a sentence end
cases.text: Dr. Li reported to the CTO [Exhibit B1, p.2]. He led four teams.
expect: Dr. Li reported to the CTO [Exhibit B1, p.2].

cases.why: a citation bracket contains a period that must not split

cases.text: Both hold [Exhibit B1, p.2; Exhibit C1, p.1]. The next one follows.
expect: Both hold [Exhibit B1, p.2; Exhibit C1, p.1].

cases.why: single-letter initials are not sentence ends
cases.text: The award went to Dr. W. Li and colleagues. It was announced later.
expect: The award went to Dr. W. Li and colleagues.

cases.text: Northwind Data Systems Inc. employs 1,800 people. It has eleven offices.
expect: Northwind Data Systems Inc. employs 1,800 people.

cases.text: The paper by Li et al. won the award. The committee cited its impact.
expect: The paper by Li et al. won the award.

cases.text: He relocated to the U.S. in 2019. He has led the division since.
expect: He relocated to the U.S. in 2019.
He has led the division since.

cases.why: question and exclamation marks end sentences
cases.text: Does the evidence support it? It does. Clearly!

cases.why: a closing quote after the period belongs to the sentence it closes
cases.text: The memo said “Atlas shipped in Q3.” The review followed.
expect: The memo said “Atlas shipped in Q3.”

cases.why: no trailing punctuation still yields one sentence
cases.text: A draft with no final period
expect: A draft with no final period

cases.why: blank input yields nothing rather than one empty sentence
paragraph breaks are whitespace like any other
cases.text:
First paragraph ends here.

Second one starts.

cases.why: a lower-case start is not treated as a new sentence
cases.text: The figure is 60% vs. baseline. Latency fell.

cases.why: the realistic paragraph the study actually produces
cases.text: As Director of AI Research at Northwind Data Systems, Dr. Li reported directly to the Chief Technology Officer and oversaw four research teams comprising 47 researchers [Exhibit B1, p.2]. The retrieval infrastructure rebuild that Dr. Li led reduced median query latency by 60% [Exhibit C1, p.1]. Dr. Li's SIGMOD 2022 Best Paper Award [Exhibit A3, p.1] further underscores his standing.
expect: As Director of AI Research at Northwind Data Systems, Dr. Li reported directly to the Chief Technology Officer and oversaw four research teams comprising 47 researchers [Exhibit B1, p.2].
The retrieval infrastructure rebuild that Dr. Li led reduced median query latency by 60% [Exhibit C1, p.1].
Dr. Li's SIGMOD 2022 Best Paper Award [Exhibit A3, p.1] further underscores his standing.
